title: g-tee-oh solution manifest
description: The manifest.json that describes one solution in the solutions library (A3 section 3, R0.7, O-117): the game configuration it was solved for, the files it is made of with their sha256 checksums, and the solve settings. A preflop solution lists its chunks; a flop build lists its lines and runouts. The document version is format_version (O-118); amounts in centi-big-blinds (cbb) are integers; formats are expressed as patterns so a validator needs no formats plugin.

format_version.description: The version of this manifest format; a reader rejects any other value (O-118).

kind.description: The solution kind (A4 solution_kind): a preflop tree in chunks, or a flop build with its lines and runouts.

source.description: Where the solution comes from (A4 solution_source): solved by this project's engine, or imported as a reference.

id.description: The solution's universally unique identifier (UUID) in lowercase hexadecimal, the same value as the solutions table row.

engine_version.description: The engine that produced the solution: a semantic version for an own solution, an opaque label for a reference solution, never a product name.

config.description: The game configuration the solution was solved for.

config_id.description: The identifier of the matching game_config row when the configuration is seeded, for example cfg_9_live_13_150 (O-112).

pair.description: The two positions of a flop build, out of position first.

flop.description: The three board cards of a flop build, rank then suit, for example Ah7d2c.

flop_weight.description: How many of the suit-isomorphic flops this flop stands for, so a flop subset weights the strategically equivalent boards correctly.

lines.description: The preflop lines a flop build was solved for, one tree per line.

runouts.description: The turn and river runouts a flop build carries, each with its per-line files.

turn_roots.description: Reserved for turn-rooted trees that extend a flop build (A3 section 2, O-15); empty or absent in version 1.

chunks.description: The node chunks of a preflop solution, in file order.

tree_hash.description: The hash of the preflop tree definition, so two solutions of the same tree can be told apart from two different trees.

seed.description: The random seed of the preflop solve.

iterations.description: How many solver iterations the preflop solve ran.

exploitability_pct_pot.description: The exploitability the preflop solve reached, in percent of the pot, one value per position.

synthetic.description: True when the solution is synthetic test data rather than a real solve, which the web app shows as a banner (O-57).

then.$comment: The property stubs let a strict validator check this required list; the shapes are defined by the top-level properties.

game_config.description: The game configuration a solution was solved for (A4 game_config): format, table size, stake, depth, straddle and ante.

format.description: Whether the game is an online or a live game, which decides the sizing conventions.

table_size.description: How many seats the table has, from heads-up to nine-handed.

stake.description: The blinds as players name them, for example 1/3 for a one and three dollar live game.

depth_cbb.description: The effective stack depth in centi-big-blinds (cbb), so 10000 is one hundred big blinds.

straddle.description: True when a straddle is posted, which adds a forced bet after the big blind.

ante_cbb.description: The ante each player posts in centi-big-blinds (cbb), zero when there is none (O-33).

config_id.description: A seeded game_config identifier: cfg_, the table size, the format and the numeric parts of the stake and depth (O-112).

position_pair.description: Two position labels joined by a hyphen, out of position first, for example BB-BTN.

card.description: One card as rank then suit, for example Kh.

line.description: A preflop line as dot-separated action tokens, for example r250.c for a raise to 250 cbb that is called.

tree_hash.description: A lowercase hexadecimal hash of a tree definition, between 16 and 64 digits.

sha256.description: The sha256 checksum of a file as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits, checked on first open.

seed.description: The random seed a solve ran with, so the solve can be repeated.

iterations.description: How many solver iterations a solve ran.

exploitability_pct_pot.description: The exploitability a solve reached, in percent of the pot, one value per position in pair order.

timestamp.description: A point in time in Coordinated Universal Time with the Z suffix, ISO 8601 (the pattern stands in for the date-time format).

file_ref.description: One file of the solution with its checksum.

path.description: The file path relative to the solution directory, with forward slashes.

sha256.description: The checksum of the file at path.

line_entry.description: One preflop line of a flop build with the settings and the result of its flop solve.

line.description: The preflop line that leads to this flop tree.

tree_hash.description: The hash of this line's flop tree definition.

seed.description: The random seed of this line's solve.

iterations.description: How many iterations this line's solve ran.

exploitability_pct_pot.description: The exploitability this line's solve reached, per position.

flop_file.description: The path of this line's flop tree file relative to the solution directory.

runout.description: One turn and river runout of a flop build with the file that holds each line's tree for it.

turn.description: The turn card of the runout.

river.description: The river card of the runout.

files.description: The runout's tree file per preflop line, keyed by the line.

turn_root.description: A turn-rooted tree for one line, reserved for later versions (O-15).

line.description: The preflop line the turn-rooted tree belongs to.

path.description: The path of the turn-rooted tree file relative to the solution directory.

sha256.description: The checksum of the file at path.

chunk.description: One zstd-compressed chunk of node records of a preflop solution.

path.description: The chunk file path, chunks/ followed by a four-digit sequence number and the .bin.zst suffix.

sha256.description: The checksum of the chunk file.

node_count.description: How many node records the chunk holds.
